note: Seerah Challenge questions. Every question names a story of the Seerah School and an 'evidence' phrase that must appear word for word in that story's text or source line (test: test/games/learning_games_test.dart). The citation shown to the player is built from the story's own source lines.

questions.prompt: In which year was the Prophet ﷺ born, according to Ibn Ishaq as the story gives it?
questions.evidence: in the Year of the Elephant (vol. 1, p. 158
questions.why: Ibn Ishaq says he was born on a Monday, the twelfth of Rabi' al-Awwal, in the Year of the Elephant. The story notes that the editor records other views on the month.

questions.prompt: Which surah of the Qur’an tells the end of Abraha’s march on the House in five verses?
questions.evidence: The Qur'an compressed the end of that march into five verses
questions.why: The Qur’an compressed the end of that march into five verses (105:1-5), Surah Al-Fil.

questions.prompt: Who died at al-Abwa when the Prophet ﷺ was six, on the way back from visiting Madinah?
questions.evidence: At six, his mother Amina died at al-Abwa
questions.why: At six, his mother Amina died at al-Abwa, between Makkah and Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who took charge of the Prophet’s ﷺ affairs after Abd al-Muttalib died?
questions.evidence: Abu Talib then took charge of his affairs
questions.why: Ibn Ishaq says Abd al-Muttalib died when the Prophet ﷺ was eight (some say ten), and Abu Talib then took charge of his affairs.

questions.prompt: What did Quraysh call him before revelation, according to Ibn Hisham?
questions.evidence: before revelation Quraysh called him al-Amin, the Trustworthy
questions.why: Ibn Hisham notes that before revelation Quraysh called him al-Amin, the Trustworthy.

questions.prompt: Whom did Khadijah send with him on the trading journey to Syria?
questions.evidence: with her slave Maysarah
questions.why: Khadijah sent him to Syria with her slave Maysarah.

questions.prompt: In which month, in the year he turned forty, did the angel come to him in the cave of Hira?
questions.evidence: In the month of Ramadan, in the year he turned forty
questions.why: In the month of Ramadan, in the year he turned forty, the silence ended and the angel came.

questions.prompt: What was the first word the angel said to him in the cave?
questions.evidence: The angel came to him and said: Iqra — Read.
questions.why: The angel came to him and said: Iqra — Read. The first revealed words are Qur’an 96:1-5.

questions.prompt: Whom did Khadijah take him to, after he ran home from the cave?
questions.evidence: Then she took him to her cousin Waraqa ibn Nawfal
questions.why: She took him to her cousin Waraqa ibn Nawfal, a Christian scholar.

questions.prompt: How long did he keep his mission hidden before the public call, by Ibn Ishaq’s account?
questions.evidence: kept his mission hidden for three years
questions.why: Ibn Ishaq says the Prophet ﷺ kept his mission hidden for three years, until Allah ordered him to make it public.

questions.prompt: From which hill did he call out to the clans of Quraysh?
questions.evidence: climbed Safa and called out to the clans of Quraysh
questions.why: When the command came to warn his closest kindred, he climbed Safa and called out to the clans of Quraysh.

questions.prompt: Which word did Bilal keep saying under the heavy rock?
questions.evidence: he kept saying: Ahad, Ahad — One, One
questions.why: Bilal kept saying: Ahad, Ahad — One, One.

questions.prompt: Who freed Bilal by offering his master a stronger slave of his own in exchange?
questions.evidence: Umayyah accepted and Abu Bakr freed Bilal
questions.why: Abu Bakr told Umayyah to fear Allah and offered him a stronger slave in exchange; Umayyah accepted and Abu Bakr freed Bilal.

questions.prompt: In the Night Journey narration, who told him his people could not bear fifty prayers a day?
questions.evidence: Musa said: your people cannot bear fifty
questions.why: Musa said: your people cannot bear fifty, so go back and ask your Lord to lighten it.

questions.prompt: To how many prayers a day did the covenant stand, for the reward of fifty?
questions.evidence: the covenant stood at five prayers for the reward of fifty
questions.why: He returned again and again until the covenant stood at five prayers for the reward of fifty.

questions.prompt: What had eaten the boycott document, leaving only the words “bismika Allahumma”?
questions.evidence: termites had eaten it except for the words
questions.why: Al-Mut’im found that termites had eaten the document except for the words “bismika Allahumma” (in Your name, O God).

questions.prompt: To which land did the Prophet ﷺ tell his companions to go, where no one is wronged under its king?
questions.evidence: go to the land of Abyssinia
questions.why: He told them to go to the land of Abyssinia, for there is a king there under whom no one is wronged.

questions.prompt: Who answered the Negus for the Muslims when he asked about their religion?
questions.evidence: Ja'far ibn Abi Talib answered
questions.why: Ja’far ibn Abi Talib answered, and recited the opening of Surah Maryam when asked for something from Allah.

questions.prompt: Who used to visit Umar’s sister Fatima to teach her the Qur’an?
questions.evidence: Khabbab used to visit his sister Fatima bint al-Khattab to teach her the Qur'an
questions.why: In Ibn Hisham’s account, Khabbab used to visit Fatima bint al-Khattab to teach her the Qur’an.

questions.prompt: To which city did the Prophet ﷺ go out to seek the support of Thaqif?
questions.evidence: he went out to Ta'if to seek the support of Thaqif
questions.why: After Abu Talib died, he went out to Ta’if to seek the support of Thaqif.

questions.prompt: How many men met him at Aqabah the year after the six men of the Khazraj?
questions.evidence: The next year twelve men met him at Aqabah
questions.why: The next year twelve men met him at Aqabah.

questions.prompt: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ send with them to teach the Qur’an and Islam?
questions.evidence: sent Mus'ab ibn Umayr with them
questions.why: The Prophet ﷺ sent Mus’ab ibn Umayr with them, ordering him to teach them the Qur’an and Islam.

questions.prompt: Which mountain’s cave did the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr enter after leaving Makkah?
questions.evidence: entered a cave in Mount Thawr
questions.why: The Prophet ﷺ left Makkah with Abu Bakr and entered a cave in Mount Thawr, below the city.

questions.prompt: How many nights did they stay in the cave, according to the hadith the story cites?
questions.evidence: has them stay in the cave three nights
questions.why: The hadith has them stay in the cave three nights.

questions.prompt: Who brought them food at nightfall while they were in the cave?
questions.evidence: Asma bint Abi Bakr brought food at nightfall
questions.why: Abu Bakr’s son listened by day to what people said of them, and Asma bint Abi Bakr brought food at nightfall.

questions.prompt: At which place, before entering Madinah, did the Prophet ﷺ found a mosque?
questions.evidence: founded his mosque there
questions.why: At Quba the Prophet ﷺ stayed from Monday to Thursday and founded his mosque there, by Ibn Hisham's account.

questions.prompt: Who carried the Prophet’s ﷺ saddle into his own house after the camel knelt?
questions.evidence: Abu Ayyub al-Ansari carried his saddle into his house
questions.why: The camel knelt, then rose, walked a little and knelt in the same place; Abu Ayyub al-Ansari carried his saddle into his house.

questions.prompt: Offered half of Sa’d ibn al-Rabi’’s wealth, what did Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ask?
wrong: For a house to live in
For a share of the date palms
questions.evidence: asked only where the market was
questions.why: Abd al-Rahman declined the offer of half and asked only where the market was.

questions.prompt: For how long did the Muslims pray toward Jerusalem in Madinah before the qiblah changed?
questions.evidence: For sixteen or seventeen months in Madinah
questions.why: For sixteen or seventeen months in Madinah the Muslims prayed toward Jerusalem.

questions.prompt: About how many Muslims were at Badr, according to al-Bara’ in the hadith the story cites?
questions.answer: A little over three hundred and ten
questions.evidence: a little over three hundred and ten
questions.why: The Muslims were a little over three hundred and ten, against Quraysh, whom a scout reported as between nine hundred and a thousand.

questions.prompt: What did Abu Aziz say the men who held him gave him at their meals?
questions.answer: Bread, while they ate dates themselves
questions.evidence: gave him the bread at their meals while they ate dates themselves
questions.why: Abu Aziz, one of the prisoners, said the men who held him gave him the bread at their meals while they ate dates themselves.

questions.prompt: Which commander, not yet a Muslim, led the right wing of Quraysh's cavalry at Uhud?
questions.evidence: Khalid ibn al-Walid, not yet a Muslim, commanding the right wing of the cavalry
questions.why: Ibn Hisham (vol. 2 p. 66) has Khalid ibn al-Walid, not yet a Muslim, commanding the right wing of the cavalry and Ikrima ibn Abi Jahl the left.

questions.prompt: Which verse says “Muhammad is not but a messenger. [Other] messengers have passed on before him”?
questions.why: The verse is Qur’an 3:144, quoted in the story of Uhud and again by Abu Bakr at the Prophet’s passing.

questions.prompt: Who killed Hamza at Uhud, by a thrown spear?
questions.evidence: was killed at Uhud by a thrown spear: Wahshi
questions.why: Hamza was killed at Uhud by a thrown spear: Wahshi, a slave of Jubayr ibn Mut’im, tells how he drove the spear in.

questions.prompt: What did the Prophet ﷺ order dug around Madinah?
questions.evidence: ordered a trench dug around Madinah
questions.why: The Prophet ﷺ ordered a trench dug around Madinah and worked on the digging himself.

questions.prompt: Who is said to have suggested the trench?
questions.evidence: Salman the Persian suggested the trench
questions.why: It is said that Salman the Persian suggested the trench.

questions.prompt: What did Allah send on a cold winter night that overturned the allies’ pots and threw down their tents?
questions.evidence: sent a very cold wind on a winter night
questions.why: Allah sowed discord among the allies and sent a very cold wind on a winter night; the Qur’an mentions the wind and the soldiers in 33:9.

questions.prompt: About how many men set out with him for umrah when Quraysh barred them at Hudaybiyyah?
questions.evidence: about fourteen hundred men
questions.why: The Prophet ﷺ set out for umrah with about fourteen hundred men.

questions.prompt: For how many years did the two sides agree to put war away, in the text Ibn Hisham gives?
questions.evidence: to put war away from the people for ten years
questions.why: The two sides agreed to put war away from the people for ten years.

questions.prompt: Which ruler read the Prophet's ﷺ letter and tore it?
questions.evidence: who passed it to Kisra; he read it and tore it
questions.why: In Bukhari 64 (Ibn Abbas) the governor of Bahrain passed the letter to Kisra, who read it and tore it.

questions.prompt: Who carried the Prophet’s ﷺ letter to Caesar, king of the Romans?
questions.evidence: Dihya al-Kalbi to Caesar
questions.why: Ibn Hisham lists the envoys: Dihya al-Kalbi to Caesar, Abdullah ibn Hudhafa al-Sahmi to Kisra, Amr ibn Umayya al-Damri to the Negus and Hatib ibn Abi Balta’a to al-Muqawqis.

questions.prompt: In which month of the eighth year did the army camp at Marr al-Zahran with ten thousand Muslims?
questions.evidence: In Ramadan of the eighth year
questions.why: In Ramadan of the eighth year the Prophet ﷺ camped at Marr al-Zahran with ten thousand Muslims.

questions.prompt: Which surah speaks of that victory and the people entering the religion of Allah in multitudes?
questions.evidence: Surah An-Nasr speaks of that victory
questions.why: Surah An-Nasr (110:1-3) speaks of that victory.

questions.prompt: After Makkah came a battle against Hawazin and their allies. Which one?
questions.evidence: After Makkah came Hunayn, against Hawazin
questions.why: After Makkah came Hunayn, against Hawazin and their allies under Malik ibn Awf.

questions.prompt: For how long were the three who stayed behind at Tabuk not spoken to?
questions.evidence: it lasted fifty nights
questions.why: The Prophet ﷺ ordered the Muslims not to speak to the three, and it lasted fifty nights.

questions.prompt: Which of the three who stayed behind gave the account preserved in the hadith the story cites?
questions.evidence: In Ka'b ibn Malik's own account
questions.why: The account is Ka’b ibn Malik’s own; Ka’b and two others, Murara ibn al-Rabi’ and Hilal ibn Umayya, were left pending.

questions.prompt: After nine years in Madinah without Hajj, in which year did the Prophet ﷺ announce that he would go, according to Jabir (Muslim 1218)?
questions.evidence: announced in the tenth year that he would go
questions.why: Jabir ibn Abdullah says he stayed nine years in Madinah without performing Hajj, then announced in the tenth year that he would go (Muslim 1218).

questions.prompt: At which place did he come down to the valley bottom on his she-camel al-Qaswa and address the people?
questions.evidence: he came down to the bottom of the valley on his she-camel al-Qaswa
questions.why: At Arafat, after the sun had passed its height, he came down to the bottom of the valley on his she-camel al-Qaswa and addressed the people (Muslim 1218).

questions.prompt: Whose house was he in when he died, on her day?
questions.evidence: The Prophet ﷺ died in the house of Aisha, on her day.
questions.why: The Prophet ﷺ died in the house of Aisha, on her day.

questions.prompt: Whom did he order to lead the people in prayer when he fell ill?
questions.evidence: he ordered that Abu Bakr lead the people in prayer
questions.why: When he fell ill he ordered that Abu Bakr lead the people in prayer.

questions.prompt: Which animal is named among the few things he left behind?
questions.evidence: nothing but his white mule, his weapons, and a piece of land
questions.why: He left no money, no slaves, and nothing but his white mule, his weapons, and a piece of land he had given in charity.

questions.prompt: Who sent Umar to his sister’s house first, on his way to kill the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.evidence: Nu'aym ibn Abdullah, who was secretly Muslim, sent him to his own house first
questions.why: Nu’aym, who was secretly Muslim, told Umar to look at his own family first.

questions.prompt: In the Prophet’s ﷺ prayer, Islam was to be strengthened by Umar or by whom?
questions.evidence: Islam be strengthened by Abu al-Hakam ibn Hisham or by Umar ibn al-Khattab
questions.why: Khabbab told Umar of this prayer.

questions.prompt: Near which hill was the house where Umar went to find the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.evidence: the Prophet was in a house by Safa
questions.why: Umar took his sword and went to that house and knocked at the door.

questions.prompt: In the Charter of Madinah, to whom is any dispute referred?
questions.evidence: any dispute is to be referred to Allah and to Muhammad
questions.why: The document also confirmed the Jews of Madinah in their religion and property.

questions.prompt: Which learned rabbi of Madinah embraced Islam when the Prophet ﷺ arrived?
questions.evidence: Abdullah ibn Salam, a learned Jewish rabbi of Madinah, embraced Islam
questions.why: This is Ibn Ishaq's account, from members of his family.

questions.prompt: How many men did a scout report for Quraysh at Badr?
questions.answer: Between nine hundred and a thousand
questions.evidence: between nine hundred and a thousand
questions.why: The Muslims were a little over three hundred and ten.

questions.prompt: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ prod in the belly while straightening the ranks at Badr?
questions.evidence: he prodded Sawad ibn Ghaziyya in the belly
questions.why: Sawad asked to take his retaliation, which the Prophet ﷺ allowed.

questions.prompt: Who told the Prophet ﷺ that was enough pleading, for Allah would fulfil what He promised?
questions.evidence: Abu Bakr told him that was enough pleading
questions.why: This was in the shelter built for him on the morning of Badr.

questions.prompt: How many angels does the story say the Qur’an mentions in 3:123-127?
questions.evidence: Three thousand angels
questions.why: The Qur'an says this was to reassure hearts, and that victory is only from Allah.

questions.prompt: What did the Prophet ﷺ tell his companions about the prisoners of Badr?
questions.evidence: Treat the prisoners well
questions.why: Abu Aziz said his captors gave him the bread.

questions.prompt: Which man of Quraysh demanded the clause returning those who came over, in Bukhari 2731?
questions.evidence: the same clause that Suhayl demanded
questions.why: The story notes the clause applied even if the man had embraced Islam.

questions.prompt: Which Companion could not bear the terms at Hudaybiyyah?
questions.evidence: Umar ibn al-Khattab could not bear it
questions.why: In Ibn Hisham he asks why humiliation should be accepted in the religion.

questions.prompt: How did the Prophet ﷺ answer Umar at Hudaybiyyah, in Ibn Hisham’s account?
questions.answer: I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger; I will not disobey His command
wrong: We will fight them next year
Quraysh will pay us for it
questions.evidence: I am the servant of Allah and His Messenger; I will not disobey His command
questions.why: He added that Allah would not let him be lost.

questions.prompt: Which sura was revealed on the journey of Hudaybiyyah, according to Bukhari 4177?
questions.evidence: the sura of Al-Fath
questions.why: The Qur'an calls it a clear conquest (48:1).

questions.prompt: Under whom did Hawazin come to Hunayn?
questions.evidence: under Malik ibn Awf
questions.why: They brought their property, women and children with them to Awtas.

questions.prompt: Where did the Prophet ﷺ gather the Ansar after Hunayn?
questions.evidence: He gathered them in a leather tent
questions.why: He asked whether they were not pleased with the Messenger of Allah.

questions.prompt: What did the Prophet ﷺ ask the Ansar to set against sheep and camels?
questions.answer: Returning with the Messenger of Allah
wrong: A share of the date palms
questions.evidence: while you return with the Messenger of Allah
questions.why: The Ansar had been dissatisfied about the spoils.

questions.prompt: What did the Prophet ﷺ give as a pledge when he bought grain on credit?
questions.evidence: given his iron armour as a pledge
questions.why: He bought it from a Jew, in Bukhari 2068.

questions.prompt: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about whatever he left behind?
questions.evidence: whatever we leave is sadaqa
questions.why: Abu Bakr cited those words to Fatima.

questions.prompt: What did Khadijah say to the Prophet ﷺ after the first revelation?
questions.evidence: Allah will never disgrace you
questions.why: She added that he keeps kinship and carries the weak.

questions.prompt: In 96:1-5, by what has Allah taught man?
questions.evidence: Who taught by the pen
questions.why: The command begins with Recite in the name of your Lord who created.
